prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright blue-white glacier ice cave lit by daylight through the ice, a flat frozen floor and a standard-height wooden walkway rail, warmly lit by the low golden sun, long soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in warm golden-hour sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Russian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a gentle soft smile, warm honey-blonde hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a tin barrel-shaped weight, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a tin round bell, a bronze cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Indian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth warm brown skin with a soft glow, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a copper round bell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal anklets. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white satin with gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
